summary: node_type rules: automationcontroller nodes are hybrid (default) or control, execution_nodes are execution (default) or hop; an instance_group_* host not in either group fails 'Validate mesh topology' with 'is not present in either [automationcontroller] or [execution_nodes]', fixed by listing it in execution_nodes too.
questions: The host is not present in either [automationcontroller] or [execution_nodes]
What node_type values can I use in the installer inventory?
How do I add a node to a custom instance group in the inventory file?
Why does Validate mesh topology fail?

answer_card.title: Fix 'not present in either [automationcontroller] or [execution_nodes]'
answer_card.answer_md:
Every host in an `[instance_group_*]` group must also be in `[automationcontroller]` or `[execution_nodes]`. Move the host definition into `[execution_nodes]` and list only its name in the custom group:

```
[execution_nodes]
110-addr.tatu.home ansible_host=192.168.111.110 receptor_listener_port=8928

[instance_group_test]
110-addr.tatu.home
```

`node_type` is `hybrid` (default) or `control` in `automationcontroller`, and `execution` (default) or `hop` in `execution_nodes`.
